summary: Build the shared read-only service transport
description: Create one audited runtime-endpoint, credential-resolution, HTTP policy, timeout, retry, typed-error, and redaction layer before any service adapter exists.
acceptance: Runtime endpoint configuration is schema-valid, external to Git, and stores base_url plus secret_ref without credential values.

Lab credential loading accepts only contained file references and rejects traversal, symlinks, wrong owner or mode, unexpected file types, multiline/NUL/header-injection content, and escapes from the trusted root.
HTTP policy enforces explicit origins, TLS verification by default, denied redirects, deterministic deadlines, response-size limits, JSON/content-type validation, and typed failures.
Retries are bounded and only for classified idempotent reads; the exact qBittorrent auth_session POST is separate, side-effect-free, and never automatically retried.
Mutation remains disabled until bounded apply integrates policy and approval.
Errors and results never expose URLs, headers, cookies, credentials, or raw response bodies; fault-api proves adversarial cases.
